subtitle: Temporal Parity & Reality Audit (2016–2026 Audit-Corrected Arc)

PFA.name: Picard's Final Act
PFA.mechanics: Dynamically bridges the cumulative deficit from the 7.5% pre-PFA trough (+67.5% applied) to lock the timeline waterline at 75.0% and open a 14-day Correction Window.

TCE.name: Temporal Convergence Event
TCE.mechanics: Uncapped surge (+2.0% to +5.0%) pulling reality toward 100.0% Prime parity and opening a 7–14 day Convergence Window where downstream Cascade Events (+1.0% to +3.0%) can fire.

TFE.name: Temporal Fracture Event
TFE.mechanics: Uncapped plunge (-3.0% to -15.0%) dismantling core constitutional, collective-security, or systemic guardrails and opening a 7–14 day Fracture Window for Negative Cascades (-1.0% to -3.0%).

scoringRules.twentyFourteenTest: Routine institutional survival, standard court procedure, and normal election turnover score 0.0% (no upward drift credit and no panic multiplier).
strictScrutinyGatekeeper: Prong 2: Causal Independence (No Double-Counting Downstream Reactions)
Prong 3: Irreversible Structural Permanence (Binding Law or Permanent Systemic Rupture)
Prong 4: Multi-Outlet Empirical Verification (2+ Independent Major Outlets)

cascadingNonsensePolicyWeight.description: Elevated drag for self-defeating, administratively contradictory policies that trigger multi-sector legal, diplomatic, or economic cascades.
